description: This Dart source file serves as an entry point for a Flutter app focused on the profile development/testing environment. It imports necessary packages and project modules, and defines a main() function to launch the app specifically configured for profile development. The file also defines a StatelessWidget class that sets up the MaterialApp with initial routes and screens related to user profiles.

classes.name: MyAppProfileDev
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that configures and builds the MaterialApp for profile testing, defining app title, theme, initial route, and route mappings.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that initializes the app by running MyAppProfileDev widget.
